theorem Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.alter.eq_def.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : α → Type v} [Ord α]
  [Std.LawfulEqOrd α] (k : α) (f : Option (β k) → Option (β k)) (t : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl α β)
  (hl : t.Balanced) :
  Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.alter k f t hl =
    match t, hl with
    | Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf, hl =>
      match f none with
      | none =>
        { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf, balanced_impl := ⋯, lb_le_size_impl := ⋯,
          size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
      | some v =>
        {
          impl :=
            Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner 1 k v Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf
              Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf,
          balanced_impl := ⋯, lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
    | Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner sz k' v' l' r', hl =>
      match h : compare k k' with
      | Ordering.lt =>
        match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.alter k f l' ⋯ with
        | { impl := d, balanced_impl := hd, lb_le_size_impl := hd'₁, size_impl_le_ub := hd'₂ } =>
          { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balance k' v' d r' ⋯ ⋯ ⋯, balanced_impl := ⋯,
            lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
      | Ordering.gt =>
        match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.alter k f r' ⋯ with
        | { impl := d, balanced_impl := hd, lb_le_size_impl := hd'₁, size_impl_le_ub := hd'₂ } =>
          { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balance k' v' l' d ⋯ ⋯ ⋯, balanced_impl := ⋯,
            lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
      | Ordering.eq =>
        match f (some (cast ⋯ v')) with
        | none =>
          { impl := l'.glue r' ⋯ ⋯ ⋯, balanced_impl := ⋯, lb_le_size_impl := ⋯,
            size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
        | some v =>
          { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner sz k v l' r', balanced_impl := ⋯,
            lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }

    match t, hl with

          | { impl := r', balanced_impl := hr' } =>
            { impl := (l'.link2 r' ⋯ ⋯).impl, balanced_impl := ⋯ }
      | true =>
        match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.filter f l ⋯ with
        | { impl := l', balanced_impl := hl' } =>
          match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.filter f r ⋯ with
          | { impl := r', balanced_impl := hr' } =>

          match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.filterMap f r ⋯ with
          | { impl := r', balanced_impl := hr' } =>
            { impl := (l'.link2 r' ⋯ ⋯).impl, balanced_impl := ⋯ }
      | some v' =>
        match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.filterMap f l ⋯ with
        | { impl := l', balanced_impl := hl' } =>
          match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.filterMap f r ⋯ with
          | { impl := r', balanced_impl := hr' } =>

theorem Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.alter.eq_def.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Ord α] (k : α)
  (f : Option β → Option β) (t : Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl α fun x => β) (hl : t.Balanced) :
  Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.alter k f t hl =
    match t, hl with
    | Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf, hl =>
      match f none with
      | none =>
        { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf, balanced_impl := ⋯, lb_le_size_impl := ⋯,
          size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
      | some v =>
        {
          impl :=
            Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner 1 k v Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf
              Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.leaf,
          balanced_impl := ⋯, lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
    | Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner sz k' v' l' r', hl =>
      match compare k k' with
      | Ordering.lt =>
        match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.alter k f l' ⋯ with
        | { impl := d, balanced_impl := hd, lb_le_size_impl := hd'₁, size_impl_le_ub := hd'₂ } =>
          { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balance k' v' d r' ⋯ ⋯ ⋯, balanced_impl := ⋯,
            lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
      | Ordering.gt =>
        match Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.alter k f r' ⋯ with
        | { impl := d, balanced_impl := hd, lb_le_size_impl := hd'₁, size_impl_le_ub := hd'₂ } =>
          { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.balance k' v' l' d ⋯ ⋯ ⋯, balanced_impl := ⋯,
            lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
      | Ordering.eq =>
        match f (some v') with
        | none =>
          { impl := l'.glue r' ⋯ ⋯ ⋯, balanced_impl := ⋯, lb_le_size_impl := ⋯,
            size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }
        | some v =>
          { impl := Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.inner sz k v l' r', balanced_impl := ⋯,
            lb_le_size_impl := ⋯, size_impl_le_ub := ⋯ }

doc:
Depending on the client capability
`workspace.workspaceEdit.resourceOperations` document changes are either
an array of `TextDocumentEdit`s to express changes to n different text
documents where each text document edit addresses a specific version of
a text document. Or it can contain above `TextDocumentEdit`s mixed with
create, rename and delete file / folder operations.

Whether a client supports versioned document edits is expressed via
`workspace.workspaceEdit.documentChanges` client capability.

If a client neither supports `documentChanges` nor
`workspace.workspaceEdit.resourceOperations` then only plain `TextEdit`s
using the `changes` property are supported.

doc:
A snippet is a string that gets inserted into a document,
and can afterwards be edited by the user in a structured way.

Snippets contain instructions that
specify how this structured editing should proceed.
They are expressed in a domain-specific language
based on one from TextMate,
including the following constructs:
- Designated positions for subsequent user input,
  called "tab stops" after their most frequently-used keybinding.
  They are denoted with `$1`, `$2`, and so forth.
  `$0` denotes where the cursor should be positioned after all edits are completed,
  defaulting to the end of the string.
  Snippet tab stops are unrelated to tab stops used for indentation.
- Tab stops with default values, called _placeholders_, written `${1:default}`.
  The default may itself contain a tab stop or a further placeholder
  and multiple options to select from may be provided
  by surrounding them with `|`s and separating them with `,`,
  as in `${1|if $2 then $3 else $4,if let $2 := $3 then $4 else $5|}`.
- One of a set of predefined variables that are replaced with their values.
  This includes the current line number (`$TM_LINE_NUMBER`)
  or the text that was selected when the snippet was invoked (`$TM_SELECTED_TEXT`).
- Formatting instructions to modify variables using regular expressions
  or a set of predefined filters.

The full syntax and semantics of snippets,
including the available variables and the rules for escaping control characters,
are described in the [LSP specification](https://microsoft.github.io/language-server-protocol/specifications/lsp/3.17/specification/#snippet_syntax).

doc:
Finds the least common subsequence of two arrays using a variant of jgit's histogram diff algorithm.

Unlike jgit's implementation, this one does not perform a cutoff on histogram bucket sizes, nor does
it fall back to the Myers diff algorithm. This means that it has quadratic worst-case complexity.
Empirically, however, even quadratic cases of this implementation can handle hundreds of megabytes
in a second or so, and it is intended to be used for short strings like error messages. Be
cautious when applying it to larger workloads.

fun {α} [ToString α] lines =>
  (have out := "";
    do
    let __s ←
      forIn lines out fun x __s =>
          have out := __s;
          match x with
          | (act, line) =>
            have lineStr := toString line;
            if (lineStr == "") = true then
              have out := out ++ (toString act.linePrefix ++ toString "\n");
              pure (ForInStep.yield out)

doc:
Produces a diff that splits either on characters, tokens, or not at all, depending on the selected
`diffMode`.

Guarantees that all actions in the output will be maximally grouped; that is, instead of returning
`#[(.insert, "a"), (.insert, "b")]`, it will return `#[(.insert, "ab")]`.

value.text:
fun s s' granularity =>
  match granularity with
  | Lean.Meta.Hint.DiffGranularity.none => #[(Lean.Diff.Action.insert, s')]
  | Lean.Meta.Hint.DiffGranularity.char => Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.charDiff✝ s s'
  | Lean.Meta.Hint.DiffGranularity.word => Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.wordDiff✝ s s'
  | Lean.Meta.Hint.DiffGranularity.all => Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.maxDiff✝ s s'
  | Lean.Meta.Hint.DiffGranularity.auto =>
    have minLength := min s.length s'.length;
    have maxCharDiffDistance := minLength / 5;
    have maxWordDiffDistance := minLength / 2 + max s.length s'.length / 2;
    have charDiffRaw :=
      Lean.Diff.diff (Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.splitChars✝ s)
        (Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.splitChars✝ s');
    have approxEditDistance :=
      (Array.filter (fun x => x.1 != Lean.Diff.Action.skip) charDiffRaw).size;
    have charArrDiff := Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.joinEdits✝ charDiffRaw;
    if
        (decide (charArrDiff.size ≤ 3) || decide (approxEditDistance ≤ maxCharDiffDistance)) =
          true then
      Array.map
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | (act, cs) => (act, String.ofList cs.toList))
        charArrDiff
    else
      if approxEditDistance ≤ maxWordDiffDistance then Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.wordDiff✝ s s'
      else Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff.maxDiff✝ s s'

doc:
Creates message data corresponding to a `HintSuggestions` collection and adds the corresponding info
leaf.

value.text:
fun suggestions ref codeActionPrefix? forceList =>
  have msg := Lean.toMessageData "";
  do
  let __s ←
    forIn suggestions msg fun suggestion __s =>
        have msg := __s;
        match (suggestion.span?.getD ref).getRange? with
        | some range => do
          let edit ← suggestion.processEdit range
          have suggestionText : String := edit.newText
          have ref : Lean.Syntax := Lean.Syntax.ofRange (ref.getRange?.getD range)
          have codeActionTitleOverride? : Option String :=
            Option.map (fun x => x suggestionText) suggestion.toCodeActionTitle?
          have codeActionTitle : String :=
            codeActionTitleOverride?.getD (codeActionPrefix?.getD "Try this: " ++ suggestionText)
          have info : Lean.Elab.Info :=
            Lean.Elab.Info.ofCustomInfo
              { stx := ref,
                value :=
                  Dynamic.mk
                    { edit := edit, codeActionTitle := codeActionTitle,
                      suggestion := suggestion.toTryThisSuggestion } }
          Lean.Elab.pushInfoLeaf info
          let map ← Lean.getFileMap
          have rangeContents : String := String.Pos.Raw.extract map.source range.start range.stop
          have __do_jp :
            Array (Lean.Diff.Action × String) → Lean.CoreM (ForInStep Lean.MessageData) :=
            fun edits =>
            have edits := edits;
            have __do_jp := fun __r edits =>
              have preInfo := suggestion.preInfo?.getD "";
              have postInfo := suggestion.postInfo?.getD "";
              have isDiffSuggestion :=
                (!match suggestion.diffGranularity with
                      | Lean.Meta.Hint.DiffGranularity.none => true
                      | x => false) &&
                    suggestion.messageData?.isNone ||
                  suggestion.previewSpan?.isSome;
              have suggestionMsg :=
                if (!isDiffSuggestion) = true then
                  have applyButton :=
                    Lean.MessageData.ofWidget
                      { id := `Lean.Meta.Hint.textInsertionWidget,
                        javascriptHash := ↑Lean.Meta.Hint.textInsertionWidget.javascriptHash,
                        props :=
                          pure
                            (Lean.Json.mkObj
                              [("range", Lean.toJson edit.range),
                                ("suggestion", Lean.toJson suggestionText),
                                ("acceptSuggestionProps",
                                  Lean.Json.mkObj
                                    [("kind", Lean.Json.str "text"),
                                      ("hoverText", Lean.Json.str "Apply suggestion"),
                                      ("linkText", Lean.Json.str "[apply]")])]) }
                      ((Lean.MessageData.ofFormat ∘ Std.format) "[apply]");
                  Lean.toMessageData "\n" ++ Lean.toMessageData applyButton ++
                          Lean.toMessageData " " ++
                        Lean.toMessageData preInfo ++
                      Lean.toMessageData (Lean.toMessageData suggestion) ++
                    Lean.toMessageData postInfo
                else
                  have diffJson := Lean.Meta.Hint.mkDiffJson✝ edits;
                  have json :=
                    Lean.Json.mkObj
                      [("diff", Lean.toJson diffJson), ("suggestion", Lean.toJson suggestionText),
                        ("range", Lean.toJson edit.range)];
                  have diffString :=
                    if
                        (match suggestion.diffGranularity with
                          | Lean.Meta.Hint.DiffGranularity.none => true
                          | x => false) =
                          true then
                      Array.foldl (fun x1 x2 => x1 ++ x2.2) "" edits
                    else Lean.Meta.Hint.mkDiffString✝ edits;
                  have diffWidget :=
                    Lean.MessageData.ofWidget
                      { id := `Lean.Meta.Hint.tryThisDiffWidget,
                        javascriptHash := ↑Lean.Meta.Hint.tryThisDiffWidget.javascriptHash,
                        props := pure json }
                      ((Lean.MessageData.ofFormat ∘ Std.format) diffString);
                  have msg :=
                    Lean.toMessageData preInfo ++ Lean.toMessageData diffWidget ++
                      Lean.toMessageData postInfo;
                  if (suggestions.size == 1 && !forceList) = true then
                    Lean.toMessageData "\n" ++ Lean.toMessageData msg
                  else
                    Lean.toMessageData "\n" ++
                      Lean.MessageData.nest 2 (Lean.toMessageData "• " ++ Lean.toMessageData msg);
              have msg := msg ++ suggestionMsg.nestD;
              pure (ForInStep.yield msg);
            match do
              let stx ← suggestion.previewSpan?
              stx.getRange? with
            | some previewRange =>
              if previewRange.includes range = true then do
                let map ← Lean.getFileMap
                have __do_jp :
                  Unit →
                    Array (Lean.Diff.Action × String) → Lean.CoreM (ForInStep Lean.MessageData) :=
                  fun __r edits =>
                  if range.stop < previewRange.stop then
                    have edits :=
                      edits.push
                        (Lean.Diff.Action.skip,
                          String.Pos.Raw.extract map.source range.stop previewRange.stop);
                    __do_jp () edits
                  else __do_jp () edits
                if previewRange.start < range.start then
                    have edits :=
                      #[(Lean.Diff.Action.skip,
                            String.Pos.Raw.extract map.source previewRange.start range.start)] ++
                        edits;
                    __do_jp () edits
                  else __do_jp () edits
              else __do_jp () edits
            | x => __do_jp () edits
          match suggestion.messageData? with
            | some msgData => do
              let __do_lift ← liftM msgData.format
              let edits ← pure #[(Lean.Diff.Action.insert, toString __do_lift)]
              __do_jp edits
            | x => do
              let edits ←
                pure
                    (Lean.Meta.Hint.readableDiff rangeContents suggestionText
                      suggestion.diffGranularity)
              __do_jp edits
        | x => pure (ForInStep.yield msg)
  have msg : Lean.MessageData := __s
  pure msg

      if (allowed && (relaxed || Lean.Elab.isValidAutoBoundSuffix✝ s)) = true then Except.ok true
      else
        if (!allowed) = true then
          Except.error
            (Lean.toMessageData "It is not possible to treat `" ++
                      Lean.toMessageData (Lean.MessageData.ofConstName n) ++
                    Lean.toMessageData
                      "` as an implicitly bound variable here because the `autoImplicit` option is set to `" ++
                  Lean.toMessageData (Lean.MessageData.ofConstName `Bool.false) ++
                Lean.toMessageData "`.").note
        else
          Except.error
            (Lean.toMessageData "It is not possible to treat `" ++
                      Lean.toMessageData (Lean.MessageData.ofConstName n) ++
                    Lean.toMessageData
                      "` as an implicitly bound variable here because it has multiple characters while the `relaxedAutoImplicit` option is set to `" ++
                  Lean.toMessageData (Lean.MessageData.ofConstName `Bool.false) ++
                Lean.toMessageData "`.").note

  Lean.CoreM Unit

value.text:
fun hints reason =>
  match hints.terminationBy??, hints.terminationBy?, hints.decreasingBy?,
    hints.partialFixpoint? with
  | none, none, none, none => pure ()
  | none, none, some dec_by, none =>
    Lean.logWarningAt dec_by.ref
      (Lean.toMessageData "unused `decreasing_by`, function is " ++ Lean.toMessageData reason)
  | some term_by?, none, none, none =>
    Lean.logWarningAt term_by?
      (Lean.toMessageData "unused `termination_by?`, function is " ++ Lean.toMessageData reason)
  | none, some term_by, none, none =>
    Lean.logWarningAt term_by.ref
      (Lean.toMessageData "unused `termination_by`, function is " ++ Lean.toMessageData reason)
  | none, none, none, some partialFixpoint =>
    match partialFixpoint.fixpointType with
    | Lean.Elab.PartialFixpointType.partialFixpoint =>
      Lean.logWarningAt partialFixpoint.ref
        (Lean.toMessageData "unused `partial_fixpoint`, function is " ++ Lean.toMessageData reason)
    | Lean.Elab.PartialFixpointType.coinductiveFixpoint =>
      Lean.logWarningAt partialFixpoint.ref
        (Lean.toMessageData "unused `coinductive_fixpoint`, function is " ++
          Lean.toMessageData reason)
    | Lean.Elab.PartialFixpointType.inductiveFixpoint =>
      Lean.logWarningAt partialFixpoint.ref
        (Lean.toMessageData "unused `inductive_fixpoint`, function is " ++
          Lean.toMessageData reason)
  | x, x_1, x_2, x_3 =>
    Lean.logWarningAt hints.ref
      (Lean.toMessageData "unused termination hints, function is " ++ Lean.toMessageData reason)

doc:
Try to log errors for unassigned level metavariables `pendingLevelMVarIds`.

Returns `true` if there are any relevant `LevelMVarErrorInfo`s and we should "abort" the declaration.

Remark: we only log unassigned level metavariables as new errors if no error has been logged so far.

signature.text:
def Lean.Elab.Term.logUnassignedLevelMVarsUsingErrorInfos (pendingLevelMVarIds : Array Lean.LMVarId) :
  Lean.Elab.TermElabM Bool

value.text:
fun pendingLevelMVarIds =>
  if pendingLevelMVarIds.isEmpty = true then pure false
  else do
    let hasOtherErrors ← Lean.MonadLog.hasErrors
    have hasNewErrors : Bool := false
    have errors : Array Lean.Elab.Term.LevelMVarErrorInfo := #[]
    let __do_lift ← get
    let __s ←
      forIn __do_lift.levelMVarErrorInfos (hasNewErrors, errors) fun levelMVarErrorInfo __s =>
          have hasNewErrors := __s.1;
          have errors := __s.2;
          do
          let e ← Lean.instantiateMVars levelMVarErrorInfo.expr
          have lmvars : Array Lean.LMVarId := (Lean.collectLevelMVars { } e).result
          if lmvars.any pendingLevelMVarIds.contains = true then
              have __do_jp := fun __r errors =>
                have hasNewErrors := true;
                pure (ForInStep.yield (hasNewErrors, errors));
              if hasOtherErrors = true then __do_jp () errors
              else
                have errors := errors.push levelMVarErrorInfo;
                __do_jp () errors
            else pure (ForInStep.yield (hasNewErrors, errors))
    have hasNewErrors : Bool := __s.1
    have errors : Array Lean.Elab.Term.LevelMVarErrorInfo := __s.2
    forIn errors PUnit.unit fun error __s => do
        error.logError
        pure (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)
    pure hasNewErrors

fun stx expectedType? =>

  do

  have __do_jp : Unit → Lean.Elab.TermElabM Lean.Expr := fun __r => do

Make sure `e` is a type by inferring its type and making sure it is an `Expr.sort`
or is unifiable with `Expr.sort`, or can be coerced into one.

value.text:
fun e => do
  let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Meta.isType e)
  if __do_lift = true then pure e
    else do
      let eType ← liftM (Lean.Meta.inferType e)
      let u ← liftM Lean.Meta.mkFreshLevelMVar
      let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Meta.isDefEq eType (Lean.mkSort u))
      if __do_lift = true then pure e
        else do
          let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Meta.coerceToSort? e)
          match __do_lift with
            | some coerced => pure coerced
            | x => do
              let __do_lift ← Lean.instantiateMVars e
              have __do_jp : Unit → Lean.Elab.TermElabM Lean.Expr := fun __r => do
                let __do_lift ← Lean.instantiateMVars e
                let __do_lift_1 ← Lean.instantiateMVars eType
                Lean.throwError
                    (Lean.toMessageData "type expected, got\n  (" ++ Lean.toMessageData __do_lift ++
                          Lean.toMessageData " : " ++
                        Lean.toMessageData __do_lift_1 ++
                      Lean.toMessageData ")")
              if __do_lift.hasSyntheticSorry = true then do
                  let __r ← Lean.Elab.throwAbortTerm
                  __do_jp __r
                else __do_jp ()

doc:
Helper function for "embedding" an `Expr` in `Syntax`.
It creates a named hole `?m` and immediately assigns `e` to it.

```lean
let e := mkConst ``Nat.zero

fun e =>
  Lean.withFreshMacroScope do
    let result ←
      do
        let info ← Lean.MonadRef.mkInfoFromRefPos
        let scp ← Lean.getCurrMacroScope
        let quotCtx ← Lean.MonadQuotation.getContext
        pure
            {
              raw :=
                Lean.Syntax.node2 info `Lean.Parser.Term.syntheticHole (Lean.Syntax.atom info "?")
                  (Lean.Syntax.ident info "m".toRawSubstring' (Lean.addMacroScope quotCtx `m scp)
                    []) }
    let eType ← liftM (Lean.Meta.inferType e)
    let mvar ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm result.raw (some eType)
    mvar.mvarId!.assign e
    pure result

Create an auxiliary annotation to make sure we create an `Info` even if `e` is a metavariable.
See `mkTermInfo`.

We use this function because some elaboration functions elaborate subterms that may not be immediately
part of the resulting term. Example:
```
let_mvar% ?m := b; wait_if_type_mvar% ?m; body

fun ex impFVars =>
  match ex with
  | Lean.Exception.error ref msg =>
    if impFVars.isEmpty = true then pure (Lean.Exception.error ref msg)
    else
      have msg :=
        Lean.toMessageData msg ++
          Lean.toMessageData
            "\nthe following variables have been introduced by the implicit lambda feature";
      do
      let __s ←
        forIn impFVars msg fun impFVar __s =>
            have msg := __s;
            do
            let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Meta.inferType impFVar)
            have auxMsg : Lean.MessageData :=
              Lean.toMessageData impFVar ++ Lean.toMessageData " : " ++ Lean.toMessageData __do_lift
            let auxMsg ← Lean.addMessageContext auxMsg
            have msg : Lean.MessageData :=
              Lean.toMessageData msg ++ Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentD auxMsg)
            pure (ForInStep.yield msg)
      have msg : Lean.MessageData := __s
      have msg : Lean.MessageData :=
        Lean.toMessageData msg ++
          Lean.toMessageData
            "\nyou can disable implicit lambdas using `@` or writing a lambda expression with `{}` or `[]` binder annotations."
      pure (Lean.Exception.error ref msg)
  | x => pure ex

Disables incremental tactic reuse *and* reporting for `act` if `cond` is true by setting `tacSnap?`
to `none`. This should be done for tactic blocks that are run multiple times as otherwise the
reported progress will jump back and forth (and partial reuse for these kinds of tact blocks is
similarly questionable).

def Lean.Elab.Term.withoutTacticIncrementality {m : Type → Type} {α : Type} [Monad m]
  [MonadWithReaderOf Lean.Elab.Term.Context m] [Lean.MonadOptions m] (cond : Bool) (act : m α) : m α

fun {m} {α} [Monad m] [MonadWithReaderOf Lean.Elab.Term.Context m] [Lean.MonadOptions m] cond act =>
  do
  let opts ← Lean.getOptions
  withTheReader Lean.Elab.Term.Context
      (fun ctx =>
        { declName? := ctx.declName?, macroStack := ctx.macroStack, mayPostpone := ctx.mayPostpone,
          errToSorry := ctx.errToSorry, autoBoundImplicitContext := ctx.autoBoundImplicitContext,
          autoBoundImplicitForbidden := ctx.autoBoundImplicitForbidden,
          sectionVars := ctx.sectionVars, sectionFVars := ctx.sectionFVars,
          implicitLambda := ctx.implicitLambda, heedElabAsElim := ctx.heedElabAsElim,
          isNoncomputableSection := ctx.isNoncomputableSection, isMetaSection := ctx.isMetaSection,
          ignoreTCFailures := ctx.ignoreTCFailures, inPattern := ctx.inPattern,
          tacSnap? :=
            Option.filter
              (fun tacSnap =>
                (have __do_jp := fun __r => pure !cond;
                  match tacSnap.old? with
                  | some old =>
                    if (cond && opts.getBool `trace.Elab.reuse) = true then
                      dbgTrace (toString "reuse stopped: guard failed at " ++ toString old.stx)
                        fun x => __do_jp ()
                    else __do_jp ()
                  | x => __do_jp ()).run)
              ctx.tacSnap?,
          saveRecAppSyntax := ctx.saveRecAppSyntax,
          holesAsSyntheticOpaque := ctx.holesAsSyntheticOpaque,
          checkDeprecated := ctx.checkDeprecated, fixedTermElabs := ctx.fixedTermElabs })
      act

fun stx kind withInfo =>
  Lean.withRef stx
    (match stx with
    | Lean.Syntax.ident info rawVal val preresolved => do
      let rs ← tryCatch (Lean.Elab.Term.resolveName stx val preresolved []) fun x => pure []
      have rs : List (Lean.Expr × List String × List Lean.Level) :=
        List.filter
          (fun x =>
            match x with
            | (fst, projs, snd) => projs.isEmpty)
          rs
      have fs : List Lean.Expr :=
        List.map
          (fun x =>
            match x with
            | (f, snd) => f)
          rs
      match fs with
        | [] => pure none
        | [f] =>
          have __do_jp := fun f => do
            Lean.Elab.Term.checkDeprecated stx f
            pure (some f);
          if withInfo = true then do
            let f ← Lean.Elab.Term.addTermInfo stx f
            __do_jp f
          else do
            let f ← pure f
            __do_jp f
        | x =>
          Lean.throwError
            (Lean.toMessageData "ambiguous " ++ Lean.toMessageData kind ++
                Lean.toMessageData ", use fully qualified name, possible interpretations " ++
              Lean.toMessageData fs)
    | x => Lean.throwError (Lean.toMessageData "identifier expected"))

fun pendingMVarIds extraMsg? =>
  if pendingMVarIds.isEmpty = true then pure false
  else do
    let hasOtherErrors ← Lean.MonadLog.hasErrors
    have hasNewErrors : Bool := false
    have alreadyVisited : Lean.MVarIdSet := ∅
    have errors : Array Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorInfo := #[]
    let __do_lift ← get
    let __s ←
      forIn __do_lift.mvarErrorInfos (hasNewErrors, alreadyVisited, errors) fun mvarErrorInfo __s =>
          have hasNewErrors := __s.1;
          have __s := __s.2;
          have alreadyVisited := __s.1;
          have errors := __s.2;
          have mvarId := mvarErrorInfo.mvarId;
          if Std.TreeSet.contains alreadyVisited mvarId = true then
            pure (ForInStep.yield (hasNewErrors, alreadyVisited, errors))
          else
            have alreadyVisited := alreadyVisited.insert mvarId;
            do
            let mvarDeps ← liftM (Lean.Meta.getMVars (Lean.mkMVar mvarId))
            if mvarDeps.any pendingMVarIds.contains = true then
                have __do_jp := fun __r errors =>
                  have hasNewErrors := true;
                  pure (ForInStep.yield (hasNewErrors, alreadyVisited, errors));
                if hasOtherErrors = true then __do_jp () errors
                else
                  have errors := errors.push mvarErrorInfo;
                  __do_jp () errors
              else pure (ForInStep.yield (hasNewErrors, alreadyVisited, errors))
    have hasNewErrors : Bool := __s.1
    have __s : Lean.MVarIdSet × Array Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorInfo := __s.2
    have errors : Array Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorInfo := __s.2
    forIn errors PUnit.unit fun error __s => do
        error.mvarId.withContext (error.logError extraMsg?)
        pure (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)
    pure hasNewErrors

- `explicitLevels` provides a prefix of level parameters to the constant. For resolutions with a projection
component, the levels are not used, since they must apply to the last projection, not the constant.

fun stx n preresolved explicitLevels expectedType? => do
  let __do_lift ← Lean.getLCtx
  Lean.Elab.addCompletionInfo
      (Lean.Elab.CompletionInfo.id stx stx.getId false __do_lift expectedType?)
  have processLocal :
    Lean.Expr →
      List String → Lean.Elab.TermElabM (List (Lean.Expr × List String × List Lean.Level)) :=
    fun e projs =>
    if projs.isEmpty = true then
      if explicitLevels.isEmpty = true then pure [(e, [], [])]
      else Lean.Elab.Term.throwInvalidExplicitUniversesForLocal e
    else pure [(e, projs, explicitLevels)]
  let __do_lift ← Lean.resolveLocalName n
  match __do_lift with
    | some (e, projs) => processLocal e projs
    | x =>
      have preresolved :=
        List.filterMap
          (fun x =>
            match x with
            | Lean.Syntax.Preresolved.decl n projs => some (n, projs)
            | x => none)
          preresolved;
      do
      let ctx ← read
      match
          List.findSome?
            (fun x =>
              match x with
              | (n, projs) => Option.map (fun x => (x, projs)) (ctx.sectionFVars.find? n))
            preresolved with
        | some (e, projs) => processLocal e projs
        | x =>
          if preresolved.isEmpty = true then do
            let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.realizeGlobalName n)
            Lean.Elab.Term.mkConsts✝ __do_lift explicitLevels
          else Lean.Elab.Term.mkConsts✝ preresolved explicitLevels

    pure Lean.Elab.Term.UseImplicitLambdaResult.no

        pure Lean.Elab.Term.UseImplicitLambdaResult.no

                  let __do_lift ← Lean.Elab.Term.isMVarApp __do_lift
                  if __do_lift = true then pure Lean.Elab.Term.UseImplicitLambdaResult.postpone
                    else __do_jp ()
                | x => __do_jp ()
            else pure Lean.Elab.Term.UseImplicitLambdaResult.no

fun e =>
  Lean.Core.transform e
    (fun e =>
      if e.isSorry = true then pure (Lean.TransformStep.done e)
      else pure Lean.TransformStep.continue)
    fun e =>
    match e with
    | Lean.Expr.const declName us =>
      pure
        (Lean.TransformStep.done
          (if (us.any fun x => x.hasMVar) = true then e.setPPUniverses true else e))
    | Lean.Expr.sort u =>
      pure (Lean.TransformStep.done (if u.hasMVar = true then e.setPPUniverses true else e))
    | Lean.Expr.lam binderName t body binderInfo =>
      pure

    | Lean.Expr.letE declName t value body nondep =>
      pure

          (if t.hasLevelMVar = true then e.setOption `pp.letVarTypes true else e))

Create an `Expr.const` using the given name and explicit levels.
Remark: fresh universe metavariables are created if the constant has more universe
parameters than `explicitLevels`.

fun constName explicitLevels => do
  Lean.Elab.Term.checkDeprecatedCore constName
  let cinfo ← Lean.getConstVal constName
  if explicitLevels.length > cinfo.levelParams.length then
      Lean.throwError
        (Lean.toMessageData "too many explicit universe levels for `" ++
            Lean.toMessageData constName ++

      have numMissingLevels := cinfo.levelParams.length - explicitLevels.length;

      pure (Lean.mkConst constName (explicitLevels ++ us))

As a result, when the user hovers over `stx` they will see the type of `e`, and if `e`
is a constant they will see the constant's doc string.

* `expectedType?`: the expected type of `e` at the point of elaboration, if available
* `lctx?`: the local context in which to interpret `e` (otherwise it will use `← getLCtx`)

doc:
Try to synthesize metavariable using type class resolution.
This method assumes the local context and local instances of `instMVar` coincide
with the current local context and local instances.
Return `true` if the instance was synthesized successfully, and `false` if
the instance contains unassigned metavariables that are blocking the type class
resolution procedure. Throw an exception if resolution or assignment irrevocably fails.

If `extraErrorMsg?` is not none, it contains additional information that should be attached
to type class synthesis failures.

signature.text:
def Lean.Elab.Term.synthesizeInstMVarCore (instMVar : Lean.MVarId) (maxResultSize? : Option ℕ := none)
  (extraErrorMsg? : Option Lean.MessageData := none) : Lean.Elab.TermElabM Bool

value.text:
fun instMVar maxResultSize? extraErrorMsg? =>
  have extraErrorMsg := Lean.Elab.Term.extraMsgToMsg extraErrorMsg?;
  do
  let instMVarDecl ← Lean.Elab.Term.getMVarDecl instMVar
  have type : Lean.Expr := instMVarDecl.type
  let type ← Lean.instantiateMVars type
  let result ← liftM (Lean.Meta.trySynthInstance type maxResultSize?)
  match result with
    | Lean.LOption.some val => do
      let __do_lift ← instMVar.isAssigned
      have __do_jp : Unit → Lean.Elab.TermElabM Bool := fun __r => pure true
      if __do_lift = true then do
          let oldVal ← Lean.instantiateMVars (Lean.mkMVar instMVar)
          let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Meta.isDefEq oldVal val)
          if __do_lift = true then __do_jp ()
            else do
              let __do_lift ←
                liftM (Lean.Elab.Term.containsPendingMVar oldVal) <||>
                    liftM (Lean.Elab.Term.containsPendingMVar val)
              if __do_lift = true then pure false
                else do
                  let oldValType ← liftM (Lean.Meta.inferType oldVal)
                  let valType ← liftM (Lean.Meta.inferType val)
                  let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Meta.isDefEq oldValType valType)
                  have __do_jp : Unit → Lean.Elab.TermElabM Bool := fun __r => do
                    let __x ← liftM (Lean.Meta.addPPExplicitToExposeDiff oldVal val)
                    match __x with
                      | (oldVal, val) => do
                        let __r ←
                          Lean.throwError
                              (Lean.toMessageData
                                        "synthesized type class instance is not definitionally equal to expression inferred by typing rules, synthesized" ++
                                      Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr val) ++
                                    Lean.toMessageData "\ninferred" ++
                                  Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr oldVal) ++
                                Lean.toMessageData extraErrorMsg)
                        __do_jp __r
                  if __do_lift = true then __do_jp ()
                    else do
                      let __x ← liftM (Lean.Meta.addPPExplicitToExposeDiff oldValType valType)
                      match __x with
                        | (oldValType, valType) => do
                          let __r ←
                            Lean.throwError
                                (Lean.toMessageData
                                              "synthesized type class instance type is not definitionally equal to expected type, synthesized" ++
                                            Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr val) ++
                                          Lean.toMessageData "\nhas type" ++
                                        Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr valType) ++
                                      Lean.toMessageData "\nexpected" ++
                                    Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr oldValType) ++
                                  Lean.toMessageData extraErrorMsg)
                          __do_jp __r
        else do
          let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Meta.isDefEq (Lean.mkMVar instMVar) val)
          if __do_lift = true then __do_jp ()
            else do
              let __r ←
                Lean.throwError
                    (Lean.toMessageData "failed to assign synthesized type class instance" ++
                        Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr val) ++
                      Lean.toMessageData extraErrorMsg)
              __do_jp __r
    | Lean.LOption.undef => pure false
    | Lean.LOption.none => do
      let __do_lift ← read
      if __do_lift.ignoreTCFailures = true then pure false
        else
          have __do_jp := fun msg =>
            Lean.throwNamedError `lean.synthInstanceFailed
              (Lean.toMessageData "failed to synthesize instance of type class" ++
                  Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr type) ++
                Lean.toMessageData msg);
          match type with
          | (Lean.Expr.const cls us).app (Lean.Expr.const typ us_1) => do
            let __do_lift ← liftM (Lean.Elab.Term.hasDerivingHandler cls)
            if __do_lift = true then do
                let msg ←
                  pure
                      (extraErrorMsg ++
                        (Lean.toMessageData "Adding the command `deriving instance " ++
                                  Lean.toMessageData cls ++
                                Lean.toMessageData " for " ++
                              Lean.toMessageData typ ++
                            Lean.toMessageData
                              "` may allow Lean to derive the missing instance.").hint')
                __do_jp msg
              else do
                let msg ← pure (extraErrorMsg ++ Lean.Elab.Term.useTraceSynthMsg)
                __do_jp msg
          | x => do
            let msg ← pure (extraErrorMsg ++ Lean.Elab.Term.useTraceSynthMsg)
            __do_jp msg

doc:
Main function for elaborating terms.
It extracts the elaboration methods from the environment using the node kind.
Recall that the environment has a mapping from `SyntaxNodeKind` to `TermElab` methods.
It creates a fresh macro scope for executing the elaboration method.
All unlogged trace messages produced by the elaboration method are logged using
the position information at `stx`. If the elaboration method throws an `Exception.error` and `errToSorry == true`,
the error is logged and a synthetic sorry expression is returned.
If the elaboration throws `Exception.postpone` and `catchExPostpone == true`,
a new synthetic metavariable of kind `SyntheticMVarKind.postponed` is created, registered,
and returned.
The option `catchExPostpone == false` is used to implement `resumeElabTerm`
to prevent the creation of another synthetic metavariable when resuming the elaboration.

If `implicitLambda == false`, then disable implicit lambdas feature for the given syntax, but not for its subterms.
We use this flag to implement, for example, the `@` modifier. If `Context.implicitLambda == false`, then this parameter has no effect.

fun {α} x => do
  let s ← Lean.saveState
  let e ←
    tryCatch
        (do
          let e ← x
          let sNew ← Lean.saveState
          s.restore true
          EarlyReturnT.return (EStateM.Result.ok e sNew))
        fun x =>
        match x with
        | ex@h:(Lean.Exception.error ref msg) => do
          let sNew ← Lean.saveState
          s.restore true

        | ex@h:(Lean.Exception.internal id extra) =>
          have __do_jp := fun __r => do
            let r ← throw ex
            ExceptT.run (pure r);
          if (id == Lean.Elab.postponeExceptionId) = true then do
            let __r ← s.restore true
            __do_jp __r
          else __do_jp ()
  EarlyReturn.runK e (fun r => pure r) fun r => pure r

doc:
Like `Meta.withRestoreOrSaveFull` for `TermElabM`, but also takes a `tacSnap?` that
* when running `act`, is set as `Context.tacSnap?`
* otherwise (i.e. on restore) is used to update the new snapshot promise to the old task's
  value.
This extra restore step is necessary because while `reusableResult?` can be used to replay any
effects on `State`, `Context.tacSnap?` is not part of it but changed via an `IO` side effect, so
it needs to be replayed separately.

We use an explicit parameter instead of accessing `Context.tacSnap?` directly because this prevents
`withRestoreOrSaveFull` and `withReader` from being used in the wrong order.

signature.text:
def Lean.Elab.Term.withRestoreOrSaveFull {α : Type}
  (reusableResult? : Option (α × Lean.Elab.Term.SavedState))
  (tacSnap? : Option (Lean.Language.SnapshotBundle Lean.Elab.Tactic.TacticParsedSnapshot))
  (act : Lean.Elab.TermElabM α) : Lean.Elab.TermElabM (α × Lean.Elab.Term.SavedState)

value.text:
fun {α} reusableResult? tacSnap? act =>
  have __do_jp := fun __r =>
    have reusableResult? :=
      Option.map
        (fun x =>
          match x with
          | (val, state) => (val, state.meta))
        reusableResult?;
    do
    let __x ←
      withReader
          (fun x =>
            { declName? := x.declName?, macroStack := x.macroStack, mayPostpone := x.mayPostpone,
              errToSorry := x.errToSorry, autoBoundImplicitContext := x.autoBoundImplicitContext,
              autoBoundImplicitForbidden := x.autoBoundImplicitForbidden,
              sectionVars := x.sectionVars, sectionFVars := x.sectionFVars,
              implicitLambda := x.implicitLambda, heedElabAsElim := x.heedElabAsElim,
              isNoncomputableSection := x.isNoncomputableSection, isMetaSection := x.isMetaSection,
              ignoreTCFailures := x.ignoreTCFailures, inPattern := x.inPattern,
              tacSnap? := tacSnap?, saveRecAppSyntax := x.saveRecAppSyntax,
              holesAsSyntheticOpaque := x.holesAsSyntheticOpaque,
              checkDeprecated := x.checkDeprecated, fixedTermElabs := x.fixedTermElabs })
          (controlAt Lean.MetaM fun runInBase =>
            Lean.Meta.withRestoreOrSaveFull reusableResult? (runInBase act))
    match __x with
      | (a, «meta») => do
        let __do_lift ← get
        pure (a, { «meta» := «meta», «elab» := __do_lift });
  match reusableResult? with
  | some (fst, state) => do
    set state.elab
    match tacSnap? with
      | some snap =>
        match snap.old? with
        | some old => do
          let __r ← liftM (IO.Promise.resolve old.val.get snap.new)
          __do_jp __r
        | x => do
          let __r ←
            Lean.throwError
                (Lean.toMessageData "withRestoreOrSaveFull: expected old snapshot in `tacSnap?`")
          __do_jp __r
      | x => __do_jp ()
  | x => __do_jp ()

Similar to `addAutoBoundImplicits`, but converts all metavariables into free variables.

It uses `mkForallFVars` + `forallBoundedTelescope` to convert metavariables into free variables.

      Lean.Meta.forallBoundedTelescope __do_lift (some xs.size) fun xs type => k xs type

doc:
Manages reuse information for nested tactics by `split`ting given syntax into an outer and inner
part. `act` is then run on the inner part but with reuse information adjusted as following:
* If the old (from `tacSnap?`'s `SyntaxGuarded.stx`) and new (from `stx`) outer syntax are not
  identical according to `Syntax.eqWithInfo`, reuse is disabled.
* Otherwise, the old syntax as stored in `tacSnap?` is updated to the old *inner* syntax.
* In any case, `withReuseContext` is used on the new inner syntax to further prepare the monadic
  context.

For any tactic that participates in reuse, `withNarrowedTacticReuse` should be applied to the
tactic's syntax and `act` should be used to do recursive tactic evaluation of nested parts. Also,
after this function, `getAndEmptySnapshotTasks` should be called and the result stored in a snapshot
so that the tasks don't end up in a snapshot further up and are cancelled together with it; see
note [Incremental Cancellation].

    [MonadWithReaderOf Lean.Core.Context m] [MonadWithReaderOf Lean.Elab.Term.Context m]
    [Lean.MonadOptions m] split act stx =>
  match split stx with
  | (outer, inner) => do
    let opts ← Lean.getOptions
    let ctx ← readThe Lean.Elab.Term.Context
    withTheReader Lean.Elab.Term.Context
        (fun ctx =>
          { declName? := ctx.declName?, macroStack := ctx.macroStack,
            mayPostpone := ctx.mayPostpone, errToSorry := ctx.errToSorry,
            autoBoundImplicitContext := ctx.autoBoundImplicitContext,
            autoBoundImplicitForbidden := ctx.autoBoundImplicitForbidden,
            sectionVars := ctx.sectionVars, sectionFVars := ctx.sectionFVars,
            implicitLambda := ctx.implicitLambda, heedElabAsElim := ctx.heedElabAsElim,
            isNoncomputableSection := ctx.isNoncomputableSection,
            isMetaSection := ctx.isMetaSection, ignoreTCFailures := ctx.ignoreTCFailures,
            inPattern := ctx.inPattern,
            tacSnap? :=
              Option.map
                (fun tacSnap =>
                  {
                    old? :=
                      tacSnap.old?.bind fun old =>
                        match split old.stx with
                        | (oldOuter, oldInner) => do
                          guard (Lean.Syntax.eqWithInfoAndTraceReuse opts outer oldOuter = true)
                          pure { stx := oldInner, val := old.val },
                    new := tacSnap.new })
                ctx.tacSnap?,
            saveRecAppSyntax := ctx.saveRecAppSyntax,
            holesAsSyntheticOpaque := ctx.holesAsSyntheticOpaque,
            checkDeprecated := ctx.checkDeprecated, fixedTermElabs := ctx.fixedTermElabs })
        (have __do_jp := fun __r => Lean.Elab.Term.withReuseContext inner (act inner);
        match ctx.tacSnap?.bind fun x => x.old? with
        | some oldOuter => do
          let __do_lift ← read
          if (__do_lift.tacSnap?.bind fun x => x.old?).isNone = true then do
              let __r ← liftM oldOuter.val.cancelRec
              __do_jp __r
            else __do_jp ()

fun declName attrs applicationTime? => do
  let __do_lift ← Lean.getOptions
  Lean.profileitM Lean.Exception "attribute application" __do_lift
      (if (declName == Lean.Name.anonymous) = true then pure ()
      else
        Lean.Elab.Term.withDeclName declName do
          forIn attrs PUnit.unit fun attr __s => do
              Lean.withExporting
                  (Lean.withTraceNode `Elab.attribute
                    (fun x =>
                      pure
                        (Lean.toMessageData "applying [" ++ Lean.toMessageData attr.stx ++
                          Lean.toMessageData "]"))
                    (Lean.withRef attr.stx
                      (Lean.Elab.withLogging do
                        let env ← Lean.getEnv
                        match Lean.getAttributeImpl env attr.name with
                          | Except.error errMsg =>
                            Lean.throwError ((Lean.MessageData.ofFormat ∘ Std.format) errMsg)
                          | Except.ok attrImpl =>
                            have runAttr := attrImpl.add declName attr.stx attr.kind;
                            have runAttr :=
                              have elaborator := attrImpl.ref;
                              do
                              let __do_lift ← Lean.Elab.getInfoState
                              if __do_lift.enabled = true then
                                  Lean.Elab.withInfoContext
                                    (tryFinally (liftM runAttr)
                                      (if (attr.stx[0].isIdent || attr.stx[0].isAtom) = true then
                                        Lean.Elab.pushInfoLeaf
                                          (Lean.Elab.Info.ofCommandInfo
                                            { elaborator := elaborator, stx := attr.stx[0] })
                                      else pure ()))
                                    (pure
                                      (Lean.Elab.Info.ofCommandInfo
                                        { elaborator := elaborator, stx := attr.stx }))
                                else liftM runAttr;
                            match applicationTime? with
                            | none => runAttr
                            | some applicationTime =>
                              if (applicationTime == attrImpl.applicationTime) = true then runAttr
                              else pure ())))
                  (attr.kind != Lean.AttributeKind.local && !Lean.isPrivateName declName)
              pure (ForInStep.yield PUnit.unit)
          pure ())

fun {m} {α} [Monad m] [MonadWithReaderOf Lean.Elab.Term.Context m] [Lean.MonadOptions m] cond act =>
  do
  let opts ← Lean.getOptions
  withTheReader Lean.Elab.Term.Context
      (fun ctx =>
        { declName? := ctx.declName?, macroStack := ctx.macroStack, mayPostpone := ctx.mayPostpone,
          errToSorry := ctx.errToSorry, autoBoundImplicitContext := ctx.autoBoundImplicitContext,
          autoBoundImplicitForbidden := ctx.autoBoundImplicitForbidden,
          sectionVars := ctx.sectionVars, sectionFVars := ctx.sectionFVars,
          implicitLambda := ctx.implicitLambda, heedElabAsElim := ctx.heedElabAsElim,
          isNoncomputableSection := ctx.isNoncomputableSection, isMetaSection := ctx.isMetaSection,
          ignoreTCFailures := ctx.ignoreTCFailures, inPattern := ctx.inPattern,
          tacSnap? :=
            Option.map
              (fun tacSnap =>
                {
                  old? :=
                    Option.filter
                      (fun old =>
                        (have __do_jp := fun __r => pure !cond;
                          if (cond && opts.getBool `trace.Elab.reuse) = true then
                            dbgTrace
                              (toString "reuse stopped: guard failed at " ++ toString old.stx)
                              fun x => __do_jp ()
                          else __do_jp ()).run)
                      tacSnap.old?,
                  new := tacSnap.new })
              ctx.tacSnap?,
          saveRecAppSyntax := ctx.saveRecAppSyntax,
          holesAsSyntheticOpaque := ctx.holesAsSyntheticOpaque,
          checkDeprecated := ctx.checkDeprecated, fixedTermElabs := ctx.fixedTermElabs })
      act

  let __do_lift_1 ← Lean.getRef

      Lean.setMCtx newS.mctx
      Lean.setNGen newS.ngen
      Lean.Elab.Term.setLevelNames newS.levelNames
      pure a

doc:
Wraps the trees returned from `getInfoTrees`, if any, in an `InfoTree.context` node based on the
current monadic context and state. This is mainly used to report info trees early via
`Snapshot.infoTree?`. The trees are not removed from the `getInfoTrees` state as the final info tree
of the elaborated command should be complete and not depend on whether parts have been reported
early.

As `InfoTree.context` can have only one child, this function panics if `trees` contains more than 1
tree. Also, `PartialContextInfo.parentDeclCtx` is not currently generated as that information is not
available in the monadic context and only needed for the final info tree.

  let st ← Lean.Elab.getInfoState
  if st.trees.size > 1 then
      pure
        (panicWithPosWithDecl "Lean.Elab.Term.TermElabM" "Lean.Elab.Term.getInfoTreeWithContext?"
          759 11 "getInfoTreeWithContext: overfull tree")
    else
      match st.trees[0]? with
      | some t =>
        have t := t.substitute st.assignment;
        do
        let ctx ← readThe Lean.Core.Context
        let s ← getThe Lean.Core.State
        have ctx : Lean.Elab.PartialContextInfo :=
          Lean.Elab.PartialContextInfo.commandCtx
            { env := s.env, fileMap := ctx.fileMap, options := ctx.options,
              currNamespace := ctx.currNamespace, openDecls := ctx.openDecls, ngen := s.ngen }
        pure (some (Lean.Elab.InfoTree.context ctx t))
      | x => pure none

doc:
Adds an `InlayHintInfo` for the fvar auto implicits in `autos` at `inlayHintPos`.
The inserted inlay hint has a hover that denotes the type of the auto-implicit (with meta-variables)
and can be inserted at `inlayHintPos`.

signature.text:
def Lean.Elab.Term.addAutoBoundImplicitsInlayHint (autos : Array Lean.Expr)
  (inlayHintPos : String.Pos.Raw) : Lean.Elab.TermElabM Unit

value.text:
fun autos inlayHintPos =>
  have autos :=
    Array.filter
      (fun x =>
        match x with
        | Lean.Expr.fvar fvarId => true
        | x => false)
      autos;
  if autos.isEmpty = true then pure ()
  else do
    let autoNames ← Array.mapM (fun x => liftM x.fvarId!.getUserName) autos
    have formattedHint : String :=
      toString " {" ++ toString (" ".intercalate (Array.map toString autoNames).toList) ++
        toString "}"
    have deferredResolution : Lean.Elab.InlayHintInfo → Lean.MetaM Lean.Elab.InlayHintInfo :=
      fun ih =>
      have description := "Automatically-inserted implicit parameters:";
      have codeBlockStart := "```lean";
      do
      let typeInfos ←
        Array.mapM
            (fun auto => do
              let __do_lift ← auto.fvarId!.getUserName
              have name : String := toString __do_lift
              let __do_lift ← Lean.Meta.inferType auto
              let __do_lift ← Lean.instantiateMVars __do_lift
              let __do_lift ← Lean.Meta.ppExpr __do_lift
              have type : String := toString __do_lift
              pure (toString name ++ toString " : " ++ toString type))
            autos
      have codeBlockEnd : String := "```"
      have tooltip : String :=
        "\n".intercalate (description :: codeBlockStart :: typeInfos.toList ++ [codeBlockEnd])
      pure
          { position := ih.position, label := ih.label, kind? := ih.kind?,
            textEdits := ih.textEdits, tooltip? := some tooltip, paddingLeft := ih.paddingLeft,
            paddingRight := ih.paddingRight }
    let __do_lift ← Lean.getLCtx
    Lean.Elab.pushInfoLeaf
        (Lean.Elab.Info.ofCustomInfo
          { position := inlayHintPos, label := Lean.Elab.InlayHintLabel.name formattedHint,
              kind? := some Lean.Elab.InlayHintKind.parameter,
              textEdits :=
                #[{ range := { start := inlayHintPos, stop := inlayHintPos },
                    newText := formattedHint }],
              lctx := __do_lift, deferredResolution := deferredResolution }.toCustomInfo)

  (extraMsg? : Option Lean.MessageData) : Lean.Elab.TermElabM Unit

value.text:
fun mvarErrorInfo extraMsg? =>
  match mvarErrorInfo.kind with
  | Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorKind.implicitArg lctx app =>
    Lean.Meta.withLCtx lctx ∅ do
      let app ← Lean.instantiateMVars app
      let msg ←
        Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorInfo.logError.addArgName✝ mvarErrorInfo
            ((Lean.MessageData.ofFormat ∘ Std.format)
              "don't know how to synthesize implicit argument")
      have msg : Lean.MessageData :=
        msg ++ Lean.toMessageData (Lean.indentExpr app.setAppPPExplicitForExposingMVars) ++
                Lean.MessageData.ofFormat Std.Format.line ++
              (Lean.MessageData.ofFormat ∘ Std.format) "context:" ++
            Lean.MessageData.ofFormat Std.Format.line ++
          Lean.MessageData.ofGoal mvarErrorInfo.mvarId
      Lean.logErrorAt mvarErrorInfo.ref
          (Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorInfo.logError.appendExtra✝ extraMsg? msg)
  | Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorKind.hole => do
    let msg ←
      Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorInfo.logError.addArgName✝ mvarErrorInfo
          ((Lean.MessageData.ofFormat ∘ Std.format) "don't know how to synthesize placeholder")
          " for argument"
    have msg : Lean.MessageData :=
      msg ++ Lean.MessageData.ofFormat Std.Format.line ++
            (Lean.MessageData.ofFormat ∘ Std.format) "context:" ++
          Lean.MessageData.ofFormat Std.Format.line ++
        Lean.MessageData.ofGoal mvarErrorInfo.mvarId
    Lean.logErrorAt mvarErrorInfo.ref
        (Lean.MessageData.tagged `Elab.synthPlaceholder
          (Lean.Elab.Term.MVarErrorInfo.logError.appendExtra✝ extraMsg? msg))
